Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4725214. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4725214, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
